name: Accrual Period Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of the first accrual period for debt instruments compared to the normal accrual period of the security.

LONG.name: Long First Payment Period
LONG.definition: Long first payment period is applicable.

FREG.name: First Regular Payment Period
FREG.definition: Regular first payment period is applicable.

SHRT.name: Short First Paymentperiod
SHRT.definition: Short first payment period is applicable.

YEAR.name: First Year Of Payment
YEAR.definition: First year of payment is applicable.

XLNG.name: Extra Long Payment Period
XLNG.definition: Extra long payment period is applicable.
